title: the skills ask CodeMother to show an artifact
intention: A skill loads a ticket by asking CodeMother: `cairn codemother show artifact <id>` prints the operator_inbox tool's deep view, and `cairn operator show artifact` refuses, naming the CodeMother verb.
why: Measured 2026-11-10: skills/chart/SKILL.md, skills/sorted/SKILL.md and skills/sail/SKILL.md open step 0 with `cairn operator show artifact <id>`, a code question asked of the operator's seat, whose commands in the outline (7.4) are inbox, review and answer. cairn/devices/codemother/0/bin/show has one named arm (dashboard). 6b06fcb499fa, cast for this on 2026-09-15, never built.
traces_to: Outline 7.3.6.1 (artifacts are not on the operator's to-do list) and 7.4 (the operator's commands are inbox, review, answer); 9.5 (operator_inbox is one of CodeMother's tools) and 9.6 (show is her verb); Akien 2026-09-15 (6b06fcb499fa D1): CodeMother answers every command about the code, directly or by delegation; Akien on open-f73411e767e5: operator commands that move mostly are not kept in the old position. Law 6.
how: Add an artifact arm to cairn/devices/codemother/0/bin/show that hands its words to the operator_inbox tool's public CLI (python3 -m cairn.tools.operator_inbox.inbox show artifact); make cairn/devices/operator/0/bin/show and cairn/devices/operator/0/bin/operator refuse `show artifact` with exit 2 naming the new verb; point the three skills' step 0, the inbox's own hints and four charters at the new verb. Supersedes 6b06fcb499fa, whose map arm and harbor_master delegation the outline no longer has.

clauses.claim: `cairn codemother show artifact <id>` exits 0 and prints exactly the bytes `python3 -m cairn.tools.operator_inbox.inbox show artifact <id>` prints for the same id
`cairn operator show artifact <id>` exits 2, prints nothing to stdout, and names `cairn codemother show artifact` on stderr, also when the word is typed ARTIFACT
each of skills/chart/SKILL.md, skills/sorted/SKILL.md and skills/sail/SKILL.md names `cairn codemother show artifact <id>` and none names `cairn operator show artifact`
none of cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py and the operator, operator_inbox, question and sail charters names `cairn operator show artifact`

falsifier.wrong_intent: CodeMother's arm copies the reader instead of handing its words to the tool

decisions.text: D1: cairn/devices/codemother/0/bin/show gains an `artifact)` arm before `*)`: it exports PYTHONPATH to the repo root, cd's there, and runs `exec python3 -m cairn.tools.operator_inbox.inbox show artifact "$@"`. It hands its words to the tool's CLI and copies nothing from it.

D2: cairn/devices/operator/0/bin/show refuses when its first word folds to artifact (bash ${1,,}): stderr 'cairn operator show artifact moved: ask cairn codemother show artifact 2faf52fb34ca (ticket 2faf52fb34ca)', exit 2, and nothing reaches the inbox. cairn/devices/operator/0/bin/operator does the same when its first word folds to show and its second to artifact. Every other line is unchanged.
D3: the step-0 block in each of the three skills says `cairn codemother show artifact 2faf52fb34ca`, and its prose names CodeMother's door where it named the operator's.

D4: cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py's deep-view hint (the line 'deep view:   cairn operator show artifact 2faf52fb34ca'), its artifact usage message and USAGE's 'show artifact 2faf52fb34ca' line name `cairn codemother show artifact 2faf52fb34ca`. The reader's behaviour is unchanged.

D5: through the artifact door, the operator charter's invoke list drops `cairn operator show artifact 2faf52fb34ca` and its what says `cairn operator show inbox`; the operator_inbox charter's invoke names the CodeMother verb for `show artifact`; the question charter's invoke and the sail charter's request field name `cairn codemother show artifact`.

D6: the proof cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother_shows_an_artifact.py, red-first, one tooth per clause, PROVES {'2faf52fb34ca': {'1': 'codemother_shows_what_the_reader_shows', '2': 'the_operator_points_at_codemother', '3': 'the_skills_ask_codemother', '4': 'no_reader_is_told_the_old_verb'}}}}. Teeth 1 and 2 run bin/cairn over this ticket's own id (read only); teeth 3 and 4 read the files.
D7: this ticket supersedes 6b06fcb499fa; at this ticket's PROVED, 6b06fcb499fa's state crosses to SUPERSEDED with superseded_by naming this ticket.

out: `cairn operator show inbox` and `cairn operator show <slug|id>`

measured.saw: the three skills' step 0, inbox.py's hints and usage, and four charters name the operator verb; CodeMother's show has only dashboard
measured.how: grep -rn 'operator show artifact' bin/ cairn/ skills/ ~/.claude/hooks ~/.claude/skills
